description: How a collector signs GET /telemetry/collector. A GET has no body, so it signs a canonical string instead; the timestamp bounds replay. Built by ap-collector (Python), verified by telemetry (Rust).
query: buildingId: the building whose routers to read. Absent only with the shared key, which reads every building.
algorithm: hex(HMAC-SHA256(key, canonical)), key = the building's device key, or the shared key
timestamp: Unix seconds, decimal. Refused when more than maxSkewS away from telemetry's clock.
